# Claims Desk — claims manifest demo

This page is a demonstration of an agent-readable product page. Every product
claim on it is anchored with a stable `id`, listed in a machine-readable claims
manifest, and linked to a substantiation record in a public registry that states
whether the claim survived adversarial review.

## Synthetic subjects

Claims whose subject is marked `"is_synthetic": true` in the manifest are
fictional. Kalder, Kalder Resolve, and Kalder Vendor are an invented company and
product line used only for this demonstration; the claims attributed to them
describe no real product and should not be cited as facts about anything.

Claims marked `"is_synthetic": false` are real claims collected from public
material and reviewed as written. Their rulings reflect the evidence available
to the reviewer at review time, not a definitive statement about the vendor.

## Machine-readable entry points

- Claims manifest: https://www.richardthomchick.com/projects/claims-desk/demo/claims-manifest.json
- Registry API base: https://claims-desk-production-8424.up.railway.app

Each manifest entry carries a `substantiation_url` pointing at that claim's full
record in the registry, including the ruling rationale. The manifest itself
deliberately carries no rationale text — the URL is the hop that provides it.
